mission_routing_note: Cross-cutting Engineer Worker infrastructure, explicitly operator-authorized. Represented as its OWN mission_id so run_mission mission-boundary validation (ew0a_loop.run_mission: task.mission_id != policy.mission_id -> refuse) stays fully in force and is NOT bypassed or weakened. config/ew0a_runtime.json is a protected path recording the 0C product authorization and is NOT rewritten: Phase 0C remains ACTIVE and incomplete. The RuntimePolicy for this bounded session carries this mission_id in-session only.

acceptance_criteria: CR1 exact reviewer payload bytes durably persisted; restart answers what the reviewer saw without reconstructing from source or prose
CR2 reloaded bytes recompute exactly packet_hash and bind to candidate_sha, mission_id, session_id, task_id, criterion identities; missing/corrupt/mismatched fails closed
CR3 every terminal dispatch attempt records HEAD_UNCHANGED_AT_DISPATCH YES or NO, never terminal PENDING
CR4 durable evidence distinguishes PACKET_BUILT, PACKET_PERSISTED, CANDIDATE_BOUND, DISPATCH_ATTEMPTED, REVIEWER_CALLED, VERDICT_RETURNED, VERDICT_PERSISTED without inferring one from another
CR5 after restart the worker cannot accidentally re-call the semantic reviewer for an already-dispatched review identity
CR6 deterministic verification durably records the exact baseline failure identity set (pytest node IDs); count equality is insufficient
CR7 the current broad run persists its exact failing node IDs
CR8 after simulated restart the system reconstructs baseline and current failure IDs and independently computes NEW_RELEVANT_FAILURES from durable evidence alone
CR9 durable append-only historical record of the 2026-08-16 crash recovery distinguishing observed fact, derived conclusion, unresolved gap; prior records not edited

CR10 using only durable evidence after simulated process loss, reconstruct task_id, session_id, candidate_sha, deterministic verification identity, exact verification failure IDs, packet_hash, exact packet bytes, candidate binding, dispatch attempt, final HEAD state, reviewer-called state, and semantic verdict if persisted
CR11 absent/corrupt/hash-mismatched/candidate-mismatched/ambiguous artifacts return explicit refusal or indeterminate state; never fabricate PASS
CR12 no Northstar product semantics, Research Store, winner policy, effective_period policy, C1 activation, production or capital authority, auto-merge, or Phase 0D work
escalation_conditions: representing this authorization would require bypassing mission checks -> STOP MISSION_ROUTING_REQUIRED
self-hosting the new mechanism for its own review creates unresolvable circularity -> document bootstrap boundary, use previously verified mechanism, prove self-hosting deterministically
a required guarantee cannot be met without product-semantic decisions -> ABSTAIN
taskspec.goal: Make certification evidence fully restart-reconstructible after process or machine loss. The 2026-08-16 real crash exposed three evidence-persistence gaps (packet bytes, terminal dispatch HEAD evidence, baseline failure identities) plus one observation-durability gap.
taskspec.title: Crash-resilient certification evidence
verification_steps: ONE final broad hermetic regression for the coherent package
persist passing/failing/skipped counts AND exact failing node IDs
compare against persisted baseline identities; require NEW_RELEVANT_FAILURES = 0

justification: Cross-cutting Engineer Worker certification infrastructure explicitly authorized by the operator after the 2026-08-16 real machine crash. Represented under its OWN mission_id so ew0a_loop.run_mission mission-boundary validation remains fully enforced; config/ew0a_runtime.json (protected) still records the 0C product mission and is not rewritten. Phase 0C stays ACTIVE and its exit gate stays UNSATISFIED. ew0a_readmodels.build_mission_summary already reports an unknown mission as deliberately-not-inferred, so no dashboard drift is introduced.
